sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run of form. Sandbach sit top with 22 points from 10 games and have won their last match, with a strong recent sequence of W-D-W-W-W. Alsager Town arrive as the division's second-lowest side with just 4 points from 10 games and are winless in their last five, making this a fixture heavily in Sandbach's favour.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tricky away trip to Dawley Town, with Stafford seeking to keep pace after their recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, host Eccleshall in a mid-table battle, though Bridgnorth arrive with momentum having won their last match. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a clash between teams separated by just one point in the standings. Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir in a meeting of mid-table sides, while Barnton host Shawbury United—Barnton unbeaten in their last two but Shawbury in dire form with five straight losses. Market Drayton Town welcome New Mills to a fixture between struggling sides, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face Telford Town in a bottom-half encounter. Finally, Crewe host Allscott Heath in another lower-table clash.
